# Technical Integration Guide: CRM, MAP and Web Visitor Identification

*Last updated July 29, 2025*

## **1. Access & Environment Setup**

### **1.1 Sandbox & Production Environments**

To ensure a controlled deployment, integrations must be tested in a sandbox before moving to production.

### **Required Access:**

| **Environment** | **System** | **Access Needed** | **Purpose** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sandbox | CRM | API Access, Test Data | Development & Testing |
| Sandbox | MAP | API Access, Test Data | Development & Testing |
| Production | CRM | API Credentials | Live Data Sync |
| Production | MAP | API Credentials | Live Data Sync |

## **2. CRM Integration**

### **2.1 Pre-Conversation Data Injection**

To personalize interactions, we preload customer data from the CRM. Below is a table of example fields that can be used.  Further discussion is required to understand the business data and fields that will be valuable to the superhuman conversation that will impact the workflow.

| **Object** | **Field Name** | **Data Type** | **Purpose** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Contact | Email | String | User Identification |
| Contact | First Name | String | Personalization |
| Contact | Last Name | String | Personalization |
| Contact | Job Title | String | Role Identification |
| Contact | Phone Number | String | Contact Method |
| Account | Account Name | String | Contextual Awareness |
| Account | Industry | String | Industry Segmentation |
| Custom Object | Custom Field 1 | String | Custom Mapping |
| Custom Object | Custom Field 2 | String | Custom Mapping |

### **2.2 Post-Conversation Data Posting**

After a Superhuman interaction, data must be recorded in CRM. Below are required examples of post-conversation mappings:

| **Object** | **Field Name** | **Data Type** | **Purpose** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Activity | Transcript URL | String | Reference to conversation |
| Activity | Summary | String | Conversation summary |
| Activity | Topics Discussed | String | Key Discussion Points |
| Custom Object | Superhuman Transcript | String | AI Conversation Logs |
| Custom Object | Summary & Insights | String | AI-Generated Summary |

## **4. Web Superhuman Integration and Visitor Matching Identification**

To match website visitors with CRM and MAP records, we require web tracking through cookies, session IDs, or other tracking mechanisms.

### **4.1 Web Tracking Requirements**

- **Tracking Methods:** Cookies, local storage, session ID
- **Required Data Points:**
    - Visitor IP
    - CRM/MAP user identifier (hashed if needed)
    - User session ID
    - Other IP to Company data such as ZoomInfo, 6sense, Clearbit, RB2B

### **4.2 Integration Steps**

1. Embed launcher script on website
    1. [https://www.1mind.com/integration-guide](https://www.1mind.com/integration-guide)
2. Capture visitor identifier and map to CRM/MAP
3. Sync session variables to 1mind launcher code to enrich superhuman dialog

### **Customer Team Action Items:**

- Provide developer resources for web implementation

## **5. Testing & Deployment Plan**

### **5.1 Testing Phases**

### **Phase 1: Initial Data Validation**

- Validate CRM & MAP data ingestion
- Ensure correct field mappings

### **Phase 2: Web Tracking Validation**

- Verify visitor ID resolution
- Confirm session persistence

### **Phase 3: Superhuman Integration Testing**

- Preload test CRM & MAP data
- Conduct mock conversations
- Verify conversation logs and CRM/MAP updates

### **Phase 4: Production Deployment**

- Migrate tested integrations
- Monitor live data sync
- Provide hypercare support
